observations: Role 503 indexes per-instance visible clusters, draw ranges, owners and geometry buffers; its component flag and shifted field address a second building transform. It uses a city-frame normal transform and handedness for shading. Nonzero range divisors, buffer capacities, encoded flags and transform contracts depend on producers not yet traced.

Role 504 chooses buildings using packed levels, frustum planes and distance thresholds; separate retained-view history adjusts level thresholds. It atomically reserves cluster output space per draw and writes visible entries. Producer-side bounds, atomic capacity, flags, work dispatch and consistency with role 503 remain unverified.

Role 505 derives procedural city-ground color, wear, wetness, snow and normal relief from packed material uniforms, mesh channels and textures. It divides world coordinates by ground.surface.y; admission and units for that field and the producer meaning of footprint and traffic channels require independent tracing.

Role 506 samples a reduced-resolution cloud target using viewport-relative coordinates. Role 507 uses six packed cloud uniforms and two baked textures, ray/sphere intersections, wind-compensated sampling and optical-depth interpolation. Their producers, viewport dimensions, input ranges, resource lifetimes and view/depth integration are not established by the shader bodies alone.
These are historical source observations, not confirmed defects or current product behavior. No shader compilation, rendering, product build, test, simulation or runtime probe ran.
